newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Branson arrives for world balloon flight. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Branson arrives for world balloon flight. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: British tycoon Richard Branson has arrived in the southern Moroccan city of Marrakesh to launch a new attempt to become the first person to fly around the world by balloon, a Moroccan official said on Monday.

"Branson arrived in Marrakesh late on Sunday night by a special flight from Switzerland...A group of British technicians and reporters are expected to arrive later at around 0300 GMT," the official at Marrakesh airport told Reuters.
He gave no other details and Branson, 46 (corrects age from 45), the flamboyant head of the Virgin group of companies, was not immediately available for comment.
The official said Branson and his two co-pilots might set out on their flight on Tuesday as the weather forecast was promising.
The Branson team chose the red-walled tourist city of Marrakesh as their launch pad because it is on the faster, southerly sub-tropical jet stream compared with the northern polar jet stream.
Rival attempts to fly around the world are being prepared by U.S. balloonist Steve Fosset and a two-man team planning a launch from Switzerland.
Branson's balloon, Virgin Global Challenger, is the second to be designed for the attempt. Bad weather forced him to put off a planned flight last year in a 900,000-cubic-foot craft.
